metadata.purpose: Track first-party dragon additions or client discoveries that do not yet have screenshot-complete records under data/dragons.
metadata.evidence_limit: Official profile summaries and installed-client tables can supplement discovery, identity, rarity, affinity, targeting, schedules, and ability wording, but they do not replace current in-game screenshots. The installed data contains unresolved progression tokens plus WIP, test, NPC, and unreleased-looking entries; presence in the client does not prove availability.

installed_client_source.source_type: Locally extracted structured data from the installed application
installed_client_source.use: First-party implementation evidence below current in-game screenshots. Use curated facts in this file for conditional recommendations; do not treat raw client presence as release confirmation.
installed_client_source.validation_result: For all 34 screenshot-audited dragons, installed data matched breed, Vanguard name, all five Habit names, and positive/negative troop affinities.

dragons_pending_full_extraction.name: Starshower
dragons_pending_full_extraction.title: The Wishkeeper
command_summary: Start of Combat: Mark each enemy dragon with Solar Flare.
Each Round: 50% chance to deal Tactical Damage and remove Solar Flare on 1 enemy with Solar Flare.
Rounds 1, 3, 7, 9: Deal Tactical Damage to 1 enemy in the same lane.
habit_summaries: Night Guardian: Each Round, chance to Cleanse 1 Negative effect from 2 other allies and grant Evade for 1 round.
Battle Subversion: Start of Combat, reduce Intelligence and Initiative of 3 enemies until combat ends.
Ill Portents: Raises Solar Flare consumption damage and can re-mark all enemies once during Rounds 6-10 if no enemy has Solar Flare.
Tactical Breach: Start of Combat, increase Tactical Damage Received of 1 same-lane enemy until combat ends.
Wishkeeper's Grace: Consuming Solar Flare reduces Damage Received for adjacent allies; Resistance strengthens it, while Advantage broadens it to all lanes.

vanguard.name: Sentinel's Wit
vanguard.verbatim: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard Increase your Tactical Damage Dealt by +16%. Increase Instinct and Initiative by +20 of the Ally deployed in the Left Flank.

confirmed_details: Night Guardian grants Evade at a 10% rate after its chance-based Cleanse.
Starfall consumes Solar Flare when its each-round Tactical Damage clause triggers.
The Starfall detailed description explicitly gates Ill Portents at 6+ Stars and Wishkeeper's Grace at 10 Stars.

dragons_pending_full_extraction.name: Vermithor
dragons_pending_full_extraction.title: The Bronze Fury
command_summary: Rounds 2, 4, 6, 8: Deal Physical Damage and Tactical Damage to 2 enemies within adjacency.
Odd-numbered Rounds: Chance to apply Protect to the other adjacent ally with the least troops for 2 rounds.
habit_summaries: Noble Sacrifice: Opening self Tactical vulnerability traded for five-round Physical suppression prioritizing a Warrior and Fire suppression prioritizing a Hunter.
Nimble Resilience: Start of Combat, reduce Damage Received and increase Initiative until combat ends.
Bronze Bulwark: Improves Command damage and Protect chance; applying Protect temporarily reduces Vermithor's Physical and Fire Damage Received.
Fury's Poise: Gains combat-long Physical mitigation per enemy Warrior and Fire mitigation per enemy Hunter.
Vengeful Fury: Once per combat while below 50% Max Troop Capacity, attacks the lowest-Instinct enemy with Physical Damage and the lowest-Intelligence enemy with Tactical Damage.

vanguard.name: Champion's Brilliance
vanguard.verbatim: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard Increase your Strength, Intelligence, and Instinct by +15. Reduce Damage Received by -8% of the Ally deployed in the Right Flank.

confirmed_details: Bronze Fury's Protect clause targets the other adjacent Ally with the least troops.
Nimble Resilience lasts until the end of combat.
Vengeful Fury explicitly triggers only once per combat.

dragons_pending_full_extraction.name: Meleys
dragons_pending_full_extraction.title: The Red Queen
dragons_pending_full_extraction.availability: Present in installed-client data; current player availability was not established by this audit.
command_summary: Scarlet Strike - Odd-numbered Rounds: Deal Physical Damage to the enemy with the highest Initiative and add 1 Laceration stack, up to 10.
Each Laceration stack reduces Initiative, enhanced by Strength.
At 2 Stars, Bleed enables a chance to apply Vulnerable; otherwise the Command can increase Physical Damage Received and add another Laceration stack.
habit_summaries: Royal Rend: Adds the 2-Star Bleed/Vulnerable or Physical-vulnerability branch to Scarlet Strike.
Battle Rush: Start of Round 1, increase own Initiative and reduce Instinct of 2 enemies within adjacency for 3 rounds.
Queen's Vengeance: Each Round, chance to gain Reflect for 1 round and add Laceration to the enemy with the highest Initiative.
Battle Guile: Start of Combat, reduce Instinct and Initiative of 3 enemies in any lane until combat ends.
The Red Queen: Rounds 3, 6, 9, deal Physical Damage and chance to add Laceration; Bleeding targets receive an additional stack.

vanguard.name: Warrior's Resilience
vanguard.verbatim: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard Reduce your Damage Received by -8%. Increase Tactical Damage Dealt by +16% of the Ally deployed in the Left Flank.
